relations: The stationary skull remains centered against black while flames flicker and change shape around its edges.
An orange flame rises from the lower jaw, anchored there but continuously varying in height and shape.
A second flame curves upward along the skull's right side, persisting with fluctuating thickness and wavering edges.
Intermittent flames appear in the nasal cavity and grow or shrink above the cranium, dancing around the skull.
caption: A shadowed human skull with hollow eye sockets and a rough, mottled surface stays centered against a black background while fire burns around it. The skull shows no apparent movement, shift, or rotation, and the framing keeps it centered against the darkness. A bright orange flame rises from the lower jaw and teeth, remaining anchored there while changing height and shape as it flickers continuously. A second flame curves upward along the right side of the skull, persisting throughout with varying thickness, reach, and a wavering outer edge. Small tongues of fire appear intermittently inside the nasal cavity, curling briefly, fading, and reappearing. A taller flame above the cranium grows and shrinks, sometimes reaching high and sometimes thinning to a faint tongue or disappearing near the crown. The visible motion is the unsteady dancing of the flames around the visually stationary skull.
